meta.name: design-guide
meta.description: Paperclip UI design system guide for building consistent, reusable frontend components. Use when creating new UI components, modifying existing ones, adding pages or features to the frontend, styling UI elements, or when you need to understand the design language and conventions. Covers: component creation, design tokens, typography, status/priority systems, composition patterns, and the /design-guide showcase page. Always use this skill alongside the frontend-design skill (for visual quality) and the web-design-guidelines skill (for web best practices).

copy.tagline: 按设计系统规范创建前端组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中保持一致的UI风格和组件复用。
copy.tagline_en: Build frontend components following design system guidelines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to maintain consistent UI style and reusable components in your project.

howto.what: Claude 会按照 Paperclip UI 设计系统来创建或修改前端组件，使用设计令牌、排版、状态/优先级系统等，并确保组件添加到设计指南页面。
howto.when: 当你要创建新 UI 组件、修改现有组件、添加页面或功能、设计 UI 元素，或需要理解设计语言和约定时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新的状态徽章组件，遵循 Paperclip 设计系统。
say.note: Claude 会使用设计令牌和状态颜色创建组件。

say.text: 为这个页面添加一个指标卡片网格，使用 MetricCard 组件。
say.note: Claude 会按照布局模式生成响应式网格。

say.text: 更新设计指南页面，添加新组件的所有变体。

howto.what_en: Claude will create or modify frontend components following the Paperclip UI design system, using design tokens, typography, status/priority systems, and ensuring components are added to the design guide page.
howto.when_en: Triggered when creating new UI components, modifying existing ones, adding pages or features, styling UI elements, or needing to understand the design language and conventions.

say_en.text: Create a new status badge component following the Paperclip design system.
say_en.note: Claude will use design tokens and status colors.

say_en.text: Add a metric card grid to this page using the MetricCard component.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a responsive grid per layout pattern.

say_en.text: Update the design guide page with all variants of the new component.
say_en.note: Claude will add a showcase on the /design-guide page.
